question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be united as a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment transforms the practitioner's status.
The yoginis hold dear one who possesses this accomplishment.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: One who attains the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
